text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 28 से 31 तक नाटक ‘The Test’ पढ़ो। फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 28 se 31 tak naatak ‘The Test’ padho. Phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the play ‘The Test’ on pages 28 to 31 of your book. Then answer.

steps.question: ___ is the eldest of Pandav Princes.

questionMeaning.hi: पांडवों में सबसे बड़ा कौन है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Pandavon mein sabse bada kaun hai?

steps.question: ___ is the teacher of Pandav and Kaurav Princes.

questionMeaning.hi: पांडव और कौरव राजकुमारों के गुरु कौन हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Pandav aur Kaurav raajkumaaron ke guru kaun hain?

steps.question: What different skills did Guru Dron teach the princes?
options: to use different arms, ride a horse and fight the enemy
steps.answer: to use different arms, ride a horse and fight the enemy
steps.modelAnswer: Guru Dron taught the princes how to use different arms, to ride a horse and to fight the enemy well.

modelMeaning.hi: गुरु द्रोण ने राजकुमारों को अलग-अलग हथियार चलाना, घुड़सवारी और दुश्मन से लड़ना सिखाया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Guru Dron ne raajkumaaron ko alag-alag hathiyaar chalaana, ghudsawaari aur dushman se ladna sikhaaya.

steps.question: What was the test?
options: to shoot the bird in its right eye
steps.answer: to shoot the bird in its right eye
steps.modelAnswer: The test was to shoot the bird on the tree in its right eye.

modelMeaning.hi: परीक्षा पेड़ पर बैठी चिड़िया की दाईं आँख में तीर मारने की थी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Pariksha ped par baithi chidiya ki daayin aankh mein teer maarne ki thi.

steps.question: Why didn't he allow the other princes to shoot?

questionMeaning.hi: उन्होंने बाकी राजकुमारों को तीर क्यों नहीं चलाने दिया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Unhone baaki raajkumaaron ko teer kyon nahi chalaane diya?

options: They failed to concentrate on the target.
steps.answer: They failed to concentrate on the target.
steps.modelAnswer: He did not allow them to shoot because they saw many things and failed to concentrate on the target.

modelMeaning.hi: उन्होंने उन्हें तीर नहीं चलाने दिया क्योंकि वे बहुत कुछ देख रहे थे और निशाने पर ध्यान नहीं लगा पाए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Unhone unhe teer nahi chalaane diya kyonki woh bahut kuch dekh rahe the aur nishaane par dhyaan nahi laga paaye.

steps.question: Why was he satisfied with Arjun's answer?

questionMeaning.hi: वे अर्जुन के जवाब से संतुष्ट क्यों थे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Woh Arjun ke jawab se santusht kyon the?

options: Arjun saw only the bird's eye, so he was focused on the target.
steps.answer: Arjun saw only the bird's eye, so he was focused on the target.
steps.modelAnswer: He was satisfied because Arjun saw only the bird's right eye and nothing else. He was fully focused on the target.

modelMeaning.hi: वे संतुष्ट थे क्योंकि अर्जुन को सिर्फ़ चिड़िया की दाईं आँख दिख रही थी, और कुछ नहीं। उनका पूरा ध्यान निशाने पर था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Woh santusht the kyonki Arjun ko sirf chidiya ki daayin aankh dikh rahi thi, aur kuch nahi. Unka poora dhyaan nishaane par tha.

steps.question: What do we need to do to be successful in life?

questionMeaning.hi: जीवन में सफल होने के लिए क्या करना चाहिए?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Jeevan mein safal hone ke liye kya karna chahiye?

options: Keep our eyes focused only on the goal.
steps.answer: Keep our eyes focused only on the goal.
steps.modelAnswer: To be successful in life, we must always keep our eyes focused only on our goal.

modelMeaning.hi: जीवन में सफल होने के लिए हमें हमेशा अपना ध्यान सिर्फ़ अपने लक्ष्य पर रखना चाहिए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Jeevan mein safal hone ke liye humein hamesha apna dhyaan sirf apne lakshya par rakhna chahiye.
